metadata.scope: Phase 44 third remediation; baseline 25f8b1c, code/test candidate 8ff544d, material HEAD 890aa6e

executiveSummary.text: CHANGES REQUESTED: canonical identity and all three previous Low findings are closed, and the normal multi-writer lease path is sound. One Medium remains because a missing writers ZSET causes a still-present pending version to be normalized before beforeCommit, allowing the same transaction to publish its uncommitted read-your-writes result to shared Redis. Four non-blocking release, configuration, and evidence Low findings were also recorded.

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.justification: No auth, permission, credential, or external-interface delta; shared-cache exposure is primarily an integrity issue.

dimensions.name: Stability
dimensions.justification: Normal owner renewal is robust, but owner-loss recovery reopens the cache too early.

dimensions.name: Performance
dimensions.justification: The low-frequency write path remains bounded; no load benchmark was run.

dimensions.name: Testing
dimensions.justification: Real 16/16 and offline 44/44 evidence is strong, but the decisive owner-loss read-through is absent.

dimensions.name: Maintainability
dimensions.justification: Canonical identity and configuration validation are centralized.

dimensions.name: Design
dimensions.justification: Owner-scoped normal transitions are correct, while ambiguous missing-owner state is not fail-closed.

dimensions.name: Release
dimensions.justification: One Medium blocks the phase and the command, configuration, and rollout contracts are incomplete.

topRisks.title: Owner loss can publish an uncommitted dictionary value
topRisks.summary: READ normalizes a still-pending version when the writers ZSET is absent, so the same transaction can cache its uncommitted V2 before beforeCommit rolls back.

topRisks.title: The documented real gate cannot be executed verbatim
topRisks.summary: The reactor root fails on zero matching specified integration tests unless the documented command adds a safeguard and verifies the target count.

topRisks.title: Lease settings are not propagated through Compose
topRisks.summary: The official .env plus Compose path cannot override the two new writer lease settings.

topRisks.title: The incompatible protocol rollout is absent from the authoritative runbook
topRisks.summary: The no-mixed-binary requirement exists only in the candidate submission.

topRisks.title: Brownfield identity assumptions lack a preflight
topRisks.summary: Actual column collation and historical invalid or non-canonical type codes are not checked before upgrade.

detailedFindings.title: Owner loss can publish an uncommitted dictionary value
detailedFindings.affectedArea: DictServiceImpl listItems and Redis write-window recovery

evidence.relevantBehavior: A missing writers key turns an existing pending version into a normal version before the transaction is forced to roll back.

detailedFindings.failureTrigger: The writers ZSET disappears while the write transaction remains active and calls listItems.
detailedFindings.failureScenario: The transaction reads its own uncommitted V2, publishes it under the newly normal version, another request observes V2, and only then beforeCommit detects the missing owner and rolls back.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: Requests can consume a dictionary value that never commits.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Keep a still-present pending version fail-closed until its recovery TTL expires and add a transaction-bound local guard against publishing read-your-writes values.
detailedFindings.betterLongTermFix: Use an explicit versioned cache transaction state or durable post-commit revision instead of inferring transaction completion from owner absence.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Delete writers, read from the same write transaction, concurrently read from another thread, and assert no payload plus eventual rollback.

detailedFindings.title: The documented real gate cannot be executed verbatim

evidence.relevantBehavior: The parent reactor binds Failsafe and fails before platform-boot when the specified IT does not exist in root.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A reviewer copies the command and gets BUILD FAILURE without running any test, or enables the safeguard without checking the target count.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: The review gate is not reproducible as documented.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Add failsafe.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false and assert completed/tests equals 16.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: The correct suite must report 16; a deliberately wrong suite name must fail.

detailedFindings.title: Lease settings are not propagated through Compose

evidence.relevantBehavior: Two environment-backed settings are declared but not injected by the production Compose service or documented in .env.example.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: An operator sets the values in .env, but the container continues to use defaults.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: Runtime lease behavior can differ from the operator's intended configuration.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Propagate both variables through Compose, document constraints, and assert docker compose config.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Resolve a non-default .env and verify the container and bound properties receive the same values.

detailedFindings.title: The incompatible protocol rollout is absent from the authoritative runbook

evidence.relevantBehavior: The no-mixed-binary requirement exists only in candidate material, while old and new writers interpret pending ownership differently.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A rolling upgrade mixes an old single-pending writer with a new ZSET-aware reader and reopens cache publication.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: A deployment can reintroduce stale or uncommitted reference data.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Add a stop-all-old-nodes, start-all-new-nodes, no-old-binary-rollback procedure to Phase 14 and README.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Add a static deployment-contract check for the Phase 44 protocol transition.

detailedFindings.title: Brownfield identity assumptions lack a preflight
detailedFindings.affectedArea: Existing sys_dict_type and sys_dict_item type_code values

evidence.relevantBehavior: The columns inherit database collation and the candidate adds no migration or portable preflight for historical identities.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A drifted case-sensitive brownfield schema or historical invalid code is no longer queryable or maintainable after canonicalization.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: Dictionary endpoints can miss or reject existing rows during upgrade.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Verify collation and enumerate non-canonical or invalid values before release; use Flyway if physical normalization is required.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Seed physical uppercase and invalid historical rows and test preflight plus CRUD behavior.

fixOrder.reason: It is the only phase-blocking data-integrity defect.
The next independent gate must be reproducible and count the intended tests.
The incompatible protocol needs an authoritative rollout contract before deployment.
The correctness-sensitive lease settings need a real deployment path.
Brownfield assumptions should be verified before stable release.

quickWins.impact: Makes the real gate executable while preventing zero-test false green.
Makes lease tuning available through the official deployment path.
Prevents unsafe rolling upgrades and old-binary rollback.
